textos.texto: Ana is short and thin. She has curly hair and big eyes. She is very kind and hardworking, but she is shy with her friends. Her friend Laura is not shy. Laura is tall and she has blond hair. Laura is very funny and friendly, and she is really nice. Ana has a brother. He is small and he is nine. He is smart but he is lazy: he is always tired in the morning, and he is angry in the morning too. Her grandmother is old, but she is strong and calm. Her grandfather is bald and he is very serious. Ana says her family is beautiful, and she is happy when she speaks with them. She is not sad in Canada.

preguntas.enunciado: Escribe un adjetivo de personalidad del hermano de Ana.
La abuela es fuerte y tranquila.

textos.texto: Excuse me, who is Marc? He is the young man with dark hair. Is he tall? No, he is short and fat. He is handsome and he is very friendly. And Sofia? Sofia is the beautiful woman with red hair. She is red-haired and she has small eyes. Is she serious? No! She is funny and happy. My cousin is brown-haired and he is really brave. He is not shy with people. My aunt is thin and she is always calm. My uncle is bald. He is a big man and he is very strong. Is he angry? No, he is tired, but he is kind. My family is not young, but they are nice.

preguntas.enunciado: Marc es el hermano de Sofia.

textos.texto: Laura is tall and thin. She is blond and she has big eyes. She is very funny and friendly, and she is never shy. Marie is short and she is brown-haired. Her eyes are small. Marie is calm and serious, but she is really kind. Laura is happy and Marie is happy too. Is Marie lazy? No! She is very hardworking and smart. And their brothers? Laura's brother is young and handsome. Marie's brother is old and bald, but he is strong and brave. He is never angry. Two families, and all of them are nice people.

preguntas.enunciado: Escribe un adjetivo de personalidad de Laura.

textos.titulo: En la foto de la clase
textos.texto: Who is the tall man? He is my uncle. He is handsome and very serious. Is he old? No, he is young. And the woman with red hair? She is red-haired, yes. She is my aunt. She is short and a bit fat, but she is beautiful. Is she shy? No, she is friendly and funny. And the dark-haired boy? That is my cousin. He is smart but he is lazy. He is always tired! And the girl with curly hair? She is my sister. She is thin, calm and hardworking. She is never sad and she is very brave.

preguntas.enunciado: La tía tiene el pelo rojo.
El tío vive con la familia.
Escribe un adjetivo de personalidad de la hermana.

textos.texto: Marie is short and thin. She is brown-haired and she has big eyes. She is friendly, funny and never shy. Her brother is tall and bald. He is old, but he is strong and very calm. He is never angry. Their cousin is young and handsome, with blond hair and small eyes. He is smart, but he is really lazy: he is always tired. Their aunt is beautiful and red-haired. She is a bit fat and she is very kind and hardworking. Is she serious? No, she is happy. Marie says: my family is not sad, my family is brave.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿De qué color tiene el pelo el primo?
Escribe un adjetivo de personalidad de la tía.
